paper_title: The first search for bosonic super-WIMPs with masses up to 1 MeV/c$^2$ with GERDA
notes: GERDA search for bosonic super-WIMPs (60 keV/c2 to 1 MeV/c2). Two limits presented: g_ae (ALP-electron, AxionElectron) and alpha'/alpha (dark photon). Primary anchor point explicitly stated: g_ae < 3e-12 at 150 keV/c2. Other data points estimated from Fig. 3 (top panel, log-log) tracing the GERDA curve, which rises with mass due to decreasing photoelectric cross section. Values approximate. Local DM density 0.3 GeV/cm3 assumed. Dark photon alpha'/alpha < 6.5e-24 at 150 keV/c2 is a separate DarkPhoton limit not extracted here. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.55, 8))
